##: Hosted in the source repo's bucket/; standard public manifest with a per-architecture url + hash.
64bit always; the arm64 block is added by release.yml only when kalide-windows-arm64.exe was released; version/url/hash are regenerated from the tag and checksums.txt.
description: kalide turns a folder of Markdown files into a slide deck and shows it in your browser.
notes: kalide is downloaded from the public GitHub Release really-knows-ai/kalide; no token is needed.
Windows ARM: the arm64 entry is present only for releases that shipped a windows/arm64 binary.
